verdict.rationale: Clerk explicitly advertises active device monitoring and per-device session revocation in the user profile UI, directly matching the user-facing part of the story. However, the evidence pack does not explicitly document admin-side dashboard controls to view/revoke all users' sessions or a one-click 'revoke all devices' bulk action. missing for 10: explicit admin dashboard session/device management UI, bulk 'revoke all sessions' action, independent/hands-on confirmation of revocation behavior.
